_**Agent (default)**_

The `zsh: command not found: --customer` error means the line continuations broke — usually a trailing space after `\`. Then `nohup` only ran the first line (hence “appending output to nohup.out”), and the next line was treated as a new command.

Use a single line (or make sure there is no space after any `\`):

```bash
nohup python scripts/ModelShapValues/calculate_shap_values.py --customer Tchibo --data-path scripts/ModelShapValues/tmp_data/tchibo_x_train_2026-09-15.parquet --cv 6 --max-samples all --kernel-explain-samples 22000 --output-dir scripts/ModelShapValues/shap_output/tchibo/tchibo_x_train_2026-09-15 > tchibo-output.out 2>&1 &
```

`2>&1` sends stderr into the same file; `&` backgrounds it. Want me to start it for you?
